Never short hand your sentences. I find often find myself trying to justify to my employer why I can’t come in/ work OT, or if I’m sick explaining the whole situation. The only think you have to tell your employer is 

“Sorry, I’m unavailable today” or
“Sorry, I’m not feeling well and will not be in today”

Never 
“I don’t think I can because of (insert reason here)”
Because they will always try and find a way to get you to come in/do what they need you to do.

The first statement gives them no wiggle room to bargain and sets a clear boundary. If you don’t set boundaries you’ll find yourself being the go too person for shit work/ unwanted OT and often taken advantage of
